extracted.name: Papa's oatmeal Cookies
extracted.description: Whats better than a Thursday night treat for our papa with a cup of hot chai and a Documentary. This recipe took exactly 20 min and about 5-10 prep. Its tasty, fluffy, moist, and a TOTAL YUM🤤. You can add walnuts, chocolate chips, or have them plain. They still hit every craving spot. *** Warning: The aroma of those cookies will invade your house and fill it with so much warmth. Its the best warmth a house could ever need.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cup old fashioned or rolled oats
instruction_lines: First, Preheat your oven to 370. Start with your wet ingredients first. In a bowl mix the butter, egg, brown sugar, vanilla extract, and peanut butter. Whisk until your shoulders hurt or use a hand mixer if you have one.
Second, start with your dry ingredients and thats your flour, oats, baking soda, and chocolates. Mix until everything is combined well. Lastly, fold in your chocolate chips until combined.

Third, scoop into even balls on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper. I used my hands 🙌🏼 because I felt like a baddie but a scoop is also fine. Bake for 15 min or until top is golden. Wait for it to cool down and Enjoy 😋
